# Homeless Child & Widows Foundation

> A registered Kenyan NGO dedicated to rescuing homeless children and empowering widows. We provide shelter, education, and sustainable support, and run the Maweni Rescue Home.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://homelesschildandwidowfoundation.org): Overview of our mission, 5 key operation areas, and 3 empowerment wings.
- [About Us](https://homelesschildandwidowfoundation.org/about): Our history since 2020, our team, and the locations we operate in.
- [Projects](https://homelesschildandwidowfoundation.org/projects): Details on the Maweni Rescue Home, Widow Business Startup, and our goal to build a Technical College.

## Empowerment Wings
- [Children Empowerment](https://homelesschildandwidowfoundation.org/children): Focused on orphans, homeless, disabled, and vulnerable children.
- [Youth Empowerment](https://homelesschildandwidowfoundation.org/youth): Providing grants, education, and support for youth-led projects.
- [Women Empowerment](https://homelesschildandwidowfoundation.org/women): Supporting widows through skills training, microfinance, and the Widows in Hospital Program.
